title: Buying Breakfast
story_description: A student buys breakfast before class and asks the price.
story_intro: It is a busy morning.
A student stops at a breakfast stall.
He wants to buy something quick and delicious.
He looks at the menu and talks to the boss.
He asks about the price and pays for his meal.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 老闆，早安！今天有什麼好吃的？
dialogue.py: lǎo bǎn, zǎo ān! jīn tiān yǒu shén me hǎo chī de?
dialogue.en: Boss, good morning! What's delicious today?

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.zh: 早安！有蛋餅、飯糰和三明治。你要哪一個？
dialogue.py: zǎo ān! yǒu dàn bǐng, fàn tuán hé sān míng zhì. nǐ yào nǎ yī gè?
dialogue.en: Good morning! There's egg pancakes, rice balls, and sandwiches. Which one do you want?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我要一個起司蛋餅。飯糰多少錢？
dialogue.py: wǒ yào yī gè qǐ sī dàn bǐng. fàn tuán duō shǎo qián?
dialogue.en: I want a cheese egg pancake. How much is a rice ball?

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.zh: 飯糰一個四十塊。蛋餅三十五塊。
dialogue.py: fàn tuán yī gè sì shí kuài. dàn bǐng sān shí wǔ kuài.
dialogue.en: Rice balls are forty each. Egg pancakes are thirty-five.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那我要一個蛋餅和一個飯糰。還要一杯熱豆漿。
dialogue.py: nà wǒ yào yī gè dàn bǐng hé yī gè fàn tuán. hái yào yī bēi rè dòu jiāng.
dialogue.en: Then I want one egg pancake and one rice ball. Also a cup of hot soy milk.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.zh: 好。豆漿要大杯還是小杯？
dialogue.py: hǎo. dòu jiāng yào dà bēi hái shì xiǎo bēi?
dialogue.en: Okay. Do you want a large or small soy milk?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大杯的。一共多少錢？
dialogue.py: dà bēi de. yī gòng duō shǎo qián?
dialogue.en: Large one. How much in total?

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.zh: 蛋餅三十五，飯糰四十，大豆漿二十五，一共一百塊。
dialogue.py: dàn bǐng sān shí wǔ, fàn tuán sì shí, dà dòu jiāng èr shí wǔ, yī gòng yī bǎi kuài.
dialogue.en: Egg pancake 35, rice ball 40, large soy milk 25, total 100 dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好，給您錢。
dialogue.py: hǎo, gěi nín qián.
dialogue.en: Okay, here's the money.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。這是你的早餐。請慢走！
dialogue.py: xiè xie. zhè shì nǐ de zǎo cān. qǐng màn zǒu!
dialogue.en: Thank you. Here is your breakfast. Take care!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝老闆，再見！
dialogue.py: xiè xie lǎo bǎn, zài jiàn!
dialogue.en: Thank you boss, goodbye!

key_sentences.en: How much is a rice ball?
Also want a cup of soy milk.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are at a breakfast shop. Order an egg pancake and a small soy milk. Ask the total price.

title: Choosing Lunch
story_description: Friends look at a lunch menu and choose what to eat.
story_intro: It is noon.
Two friends are very hungry.
They are standing in front of a restaurant.
They look at the menu together.
They discuss what they want and why.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你餓了嗎？我們去吃午飯吧。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ è le ma? wǒ men qù chī wǔ fàn ba.
dialogue.en: Mark, are you hungry? Let's go eat lunch.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我現在很餓。你想吃什麼？
dialogue.py: hǎo a, wǒ xiàn zài hěn è. nǐ xiǎng chī shén me?
dialogue.en: Sure, I'm very hungry now. What do you want to eat?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 看，這家餐廳的便當看起來不錯。
dialogue.py: kàn, zhè jiā cān tīng de biàn dāng kàn qǐ lái bù cuò.
dialogue.en: Look, the bento boxes at this restaurant look good.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有什麼口味的？
dialogue.py: yǒu shén me kǒu wèi de?
dialogue.en: What flavors are there?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 有雞腿便當、排骨便當和魚排便當。
dialogue.py: yǒu jī tuǐ biàn dāng, pái gǔ biàn dāng hé yú pái biàn dāng.
dialogue.en: There's chicken leg bento, pork chop bento, and fish fillet bento.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 雞腿便當多少錢？
dialogue.py: jī tuǐ biàn dāng duō shǎo qián?
dialogue.en: How much is the chicken leg bento?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 一百一十塊。排骨便當一百塊。
dialogue.py: yī bǎi yī shí kuài. pái gǔ biàn dāng yī bǎi kuài.
dialogue.en: 110 dollars. Pork chop bento is 100.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我想吃雞腿，但是今天不想吃太貴的。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng chī jī tuǐ, dàn shì jīn tiān bù xiǎng chī tài guì de.
dialogue.en: I want to eat chicken leg, but I don't want to eat anything too expensive today.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 那吃排骨便當吧，味道也很好。
dialogue.py: nà chī pái gǔ biàn dāng ba, wèi dào yě hěn hǎo.
dialogue.en: Then let's eat the pork chop bento, the taste is also very good.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好。你要喝湯嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo. nǐ yào hē tāng ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. Do you want to drink soup?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 要。我們點兩個排骨便當和兩碗湯吧。
dialogue.py: yào. wǒ men diǎn liǎng gè pái gǔ biàn dāng hé liǎng wǎn tāng ba.
dialogue.en: Yes. Let's order two pork chop bentos and two bowls of soup.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。進去坐吧。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. jìn qù zuò ba.
dialogue.en: No problem. Let's go in and sit down.

title: At a Convenience Store
story_description: A customer buys water, snacks, and tissues.
story_intro: It is a hot afternoon.
A customer enters a convenience store.
He needs several items.
He searches for water and snacks.
He talks to the clerk and pays.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好，請問礦泉水在哪裡？
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, qǐng wèn kuàng quán shuǐ zài nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.en: Hello, excuse me, where is the mineral water?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 在後面的冰箱裡。你要哪一種？
dialogue.py: zài hòu miàn de bīng xiāng lǐ. nǐ yào nǎ yī zhǒng?
dialogue.en: In the fridge at the back. Which kind do you want?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我要一瓶大的。還有洋芋片在那裡嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ yào yī píng dà de. hái yǒu yáng yù piàn zài nà lǐ ma?
dialogue.en: I want a large bottle. Also, are the potato chips over there?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 對，在那排架子上。有原味和辣味的。
dialogue.py: duì, zài nà pái jià zi shàng. yǒu yuán wèi hé là wèi de.
dialogue.en: Yes, on that row of shelves. There are original and spicy flavors.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我要一包辣味的。還要一包面紙。
dialogue.py: wǒ yào yī bāo là wèi de. hái yǒu yī bāo miàn zhǐ.
dialogue.en: I want a bag of spicy ones. And a pack of tissues.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 面紙在櫃檯旁邊。還要別的嗎？
dialogue.py: miàn zhǐ zài guì tái páng biān. hái yào bié de ma?
dialogue.en: Tissues are next to the counter. Anything else?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不用了，謝謝。一共多少錢？
dialogue.py: bù yòng le, xiè xie. yī gòng duō shǎo qián?
dialogue.en: No more, thanks. How much in total?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 水三十塊，洋芋片二十五塊，面紙十塊，一共六十五塊。
dialogue.py: shuǐ sān shí kuài, yáng yù piàn èr shí wǔ kuài, miàn zhǐ shí kuài, yī gòng liù shí wǔ kuài.
dialogue.en: Water is 30, chips are 25, tissues are 10, total 65 dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我可以刷卡嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ kě yǐ shuā kǎ ma?
dialogue.en: Can I swipe my card?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 可以。請在這裡感應。
dialogue.py: kě yǐ. qǐng zài zhè lǐ gǎn yìng.
dialogue.en: Yes. Please tap here.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。謝謝。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. xiè xie.
dialogue.en: Okay. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。發票在裡面。再見！
dialogue.py: xiè xie. fā piào zài lǐ miàn. zài jiàn!
dialogue.en: Thank you. The receipt is inside. Goodbye!

title: Clothes for a Party
story_description: Two friends choose clothes for a birthday party.
story_intro: There is a party tonight.
Mark is going to his friend's birthday party.
He is choosing his clothes in front of a mirror.
His friend gives him some advice.
They talk about what looks good and what is appropriate.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你覺得我今晚穿哪件衣服比較好？
dialogue.py: nǐ jué de wǒ jīn wǎn chuān nǎ jiàn yī fu bǐ jiào hǎo?
dialogue.en: Which piece of clothing do you think I should wear tonight?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 今晚是正式的舞會嗎？
dialogue.py: jīn wǎn shì zhèng shì de wǔ huì ma?
dialogue.en: Is it a formal ball tonight?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不是，只是一個小型的生日派對。
dialogue.py: bù shì, zhǐ shì yī gè xiǎo xíng de shēng rì pài duì.
dialogue.en: No, just a small birthday party.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 那穿這件紅色的毛衣搭配牛仔褲怎麼樣？
dialogue.py: nà chuān zhè jiàn hóng sè de máo yī dā pèi niú zǎi kù zěn me yàng?
dialogue.en: Then how about wearing this red sweater with jeans?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我覺得紅色太亮了，我不習慣穿紅色的。
dialogue.py: wǒ jué de hóng sè tài liàng le, wǒ bù xí guàn chuān hóng sè de.
dialogue.en: I think red is too bright, I'm not used to wearing red.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 那這件深藍色的襯衫呢？看起來很穩重。
dialogue.py: nà zhè jiàn shēn lán sè de chèn shān ne? kàn qǐ lái hěn wěn zhòng.
dialogue.en: Then how about this dark blue shirt? It looks steady/composed.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這件襯衫不錯。但是現在外面有點兒冷。
dialogue.py: en, zhè jiàn chèn shān bù cuò. dàn shì xiàn zài wài miàn yǒu diǎn r lěng.
dialogue.en: Hmm, this shirt is not bad. But it's a bit cold outside now.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你可以外面再加一件黑色的外套。這樣既保暖又帥氣。
dialogue.py: nǐ kě yǐ wài miàn zài jiā yī jiàn hēi sè de wài tào. zhè yàng jì bǎo nuǎn yòu shuài qì.
dialogue.en: You can add a black jacket on the outside. This way it's both warm and handsome.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好主意！鞋子穿運動鞋可以嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo zhǔ yì! xié zi chuān yùn dòng xié kě yǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Good idea! Are sneakers okay for shoes?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 派對的話，運動鞋沒問題，很休閒。
dialogue.py: pài duì de huà, yùn dòng xié méi wèn tí, hěn xiū xián.
dialogue.en: For a party, sneakers are no problem, very casual.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了。謝謝你的建議！
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le. xiè xie nǐ de jiàn yì!
dialogue.en: Great. Thanks for your advice!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。祝你玩得開心！
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. zhù nǐ wán de kāi xīn!
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Have a good time!

I'm not used to wearing red.

title: Making Plans
story_description: Two friends plan to meet after school.
story_intro: School is almost over.
Two friends want to spend time together.
They talk about going to the library or a café.
They decide on a time and a place to meet.
They confirm the plan before leaving.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，你放學以後有空嗎？
dialogue.py: dà wèi, nǐ fàng xué yǐ hòu yǒu kòng ma?
dialogue.en: David, are you free after school?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 有空，你有什麼事嗎？
dialogue.py: yǒu kòng, nǐ yǒu shén me shì ma?
dialogue.en: Yes, I am. Is something up?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我想去那家新開的咖啡店，你要一起去嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng qù nà jiā xīn kāi de kā fēi diàn, nǐ yào yī qǐ qù ma?
dialogue.en: I want to go to that newly opened café, do you want to go together?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好啊！我聽說那裡的拿鐵很好喝。
dialogue.py: hǎo a! wǒ tīng shuō nà lǐ de ná tiě hěn hǎo hē.
dialogue.en: Sure! I heard the lattes there are very good.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那我們幾點見面？
dialogue.py: nà wǒ men jǐ diǎn jiàn miàn?
dialogue.en: Then what time shall we meet?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 四點半可以嗎？我得先去圖書館還一本書。
dialogue.py: sì diǎn bàn kě yǐ ma? wǒ děi xiān qù tú shū guǎn huán yī běn shū.
dialogue.en: Is 4:30 okay? I have to go to the library first to return a book.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 可以。四點半在那家店門口見。
dialogue.py: kě yǐ. sì diǎn bàn zài nà jiā diàn mén kǒu jiàn.
dialogue.en: Can do. Meet at the shop's entrance at 4:30.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 在那家店門口...等一下，那家店在哪裡？
dialogue.py: zài nà jiā diàn mén kǒu... děng yī xià, nà jiā diàn zài nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.en: At the shop's entrance... wait a second, where is that shop?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 就在學校後門對面，郵局旁邊。
dialogue.py: jiù zài xué xiào hòu mén duì miàn, yóu jú páng biān.
dialogue.en: It's right opposite the school's back gate, next to the post office.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 喔，我知道了。那沒問題。
dialogue.py: ō, wǒ zhī dào le. nà méi wèn tí.
dialogue.en: Oh, I know it. Then no problem.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，那我們四點半見。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, nà wǒ men sì diǎn bàn jiàn.
dialogue.en: Okay, see you at 4:30.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 不見不散！
dialogue.py: bù jiàn bù sàn!
dialogue.en: Be there or be square!

title: Sorry, I Am Busy
story_description: A friend invites another friend out, but they are busy.
story_intro: A student has a concert ticket.
He wants to invite his friend to go with him.
But his friend has a lot of things to do.
They talk about work and study.
They try to find another time to meet.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，我這有兩張音樂會的票。你週五晚上想去嗎？
dialogue.py: dà wèi, wǒ zhè yǒu liǎng zhāng yīn yuè huì de piào. nǐ zhōu wǔ wǎn shang xiǎng qù ma?
dialogue.en: David, I have two concert tickets here. Do you want to go on Friday night?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 真可惜，我週五晚上得加班，沒辦法去。
dialogue.py: zhēn kě xī, wǒ zhōu wǔ wǎn shang děi jiā bān, méi bàn fǎ qù.
dialogue.en: What a pity, I have to work overtime on Friday night, I can't go.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你要加班到幾點？音樂會八點才開始。
dialogue.py: nǐ yào jiā bān dào jǐ diǎn? yīn yuè huì bā diǎn cái kāi shǐ.
dialogue.en: Until what time do you have to work? The concert doesn't start until 8:00.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我大約要忙到九點。最近公司事很多。
dialogue.py: wǒ dà yuē yào máng dào jiǔ diǎn. zuì jìn gōng sī shì hěn duō.
dialogue.en: I'll be busy until about 9:00. There's a lot of business at the company lately.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那太遺憾了。週六呢？你週六有空嗎？
dialogue.py: nà tài yí hàn le. zhōu liù ne? nǐ zhōu liù yǒu kòng ma?
dialogue.en: That's a shame. How about Saturday? Are you free on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 週六上午我要去補習班學日文，下午要陪家人。
dialogue.py: zhōu liù shàng wǔ wǒ yào qù bǔ xí bān xué rì wén, xià wǔ yào péi jiā rén.
dialogue.en: Saturday morning I'm going to a cram school to learn Japanese, and in the afternoon I have to accompany my family.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你真的很忙啊！那你什麼時候才有空？
dialogue.py: nǐ zhēn de hěn máng a! nà nǐ shén me shí hou cái yǒu kòng?
dialogue.en: You're really busy! Then when will you be free?

dialogue.speaker: David

dialogue.py: zhōu rì ba. zhōu rì wǒ kě yǐ zhěng tiān xiū xi.
dialogue.en: Sunday, probably. I can rest all day Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好，那我們週日一起吃午飯吧。
dialogue.py: hǎo, wǒ men zhōu rì yī qǐ chī wǔ fàn ba.
dialogue.en: Okay, then let's eat lunch together on Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 太好了！這次換我請客，向你道歉。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le! zhè cì huàn wǒ qǐng kè, xiàng nǐ dào qiàn.

title: At the Library
story_description: A student asks the librarian where to find a book.
story_intro: The library is a quiet place.
A student is looking for a specific book.
He goes to the help desk.
He talks to the librarian.
He asks about borrowing rules and locations.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 老師，你好。請問中文書在哪裡？
dialogue.py: lǎo shī, nǐ hǎo. qǐng wèn zhōng wén shū zài nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.en: Teacher (Librarian), hello. Where are the Chinese books?

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.zh: 中文書在二樓。你找哪一類的書？
dialogue.py: zhōng wén shū zài èr lóu. nǐ zhǎo nǎ yī lèi de shū?
dialogue.en: Chinese books are on the second floor. What kind of books are you looking for?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我想找一本關於中國歷史的書。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī běn guān yú zhōng guó lì shǐ de shū.
dialogue.en: I'm looking for a book about Chinese history.

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.zh: 歷史類的書在 205 架子上。那邊有電腦可以查詢。
dialogue.py: lì shǐ lèi de shū zài èr líng wǔ jià zi shàng. nà biān yǒu diàn nǎo kě yǐ chá xún.
dialogue.en: History books are on shelf 205. There's a computer over there to search.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。請問我可以借這本書回家嗎？
dialogue.py: xiè xie. qǐng wèn wǒ kě yǐ jiè zhè běn shū huí jiā ma?
dialogue.en: Thanks. May I borrow this book to take home?

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.zh: 可以。你有借書證嗎？
dialogue.py: kě yǐ. nǐ yǒu jiè shū zhèng ma?
dialogue.en: Yes. Do you have a library card?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有。一張借書證可以借幾本書？
dialogue.py: yǒu. yī zhāng jiè shū zhèng kě yǐ jiè jǐ běn shū?
dialogue.en: Yes. How many books can one library card borrow?

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.zh: 最多可以借十本，借期是一次一個月。
dialogue.py: zuì duō kě yǐ jiè shí běn, jiè qī shì yī cì yī gè yuè.
dialogue.en: You can borrow up to ten books; the borrowing period is one month at a time.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 如果到期了，可以續借嗎？
dialogue.py: rú guǒ dào qī le, kě yǐ xù jiè ma?
dialogue.en: If it's due, can I renew it?

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.zh: 只要沒有別人預約，就可以續借一次。
dialogue.py: zhǐ yào méi yǒu bié rén yù yuē, jiù kě yǐ xù jiè yī cì.
dialogue.en: As long as no one else has reserved it, you can renew it once.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，我明白了。謝謝老師。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, wǒ míng bai le. xiè xie lǎo shī.
dialogue.en: Okay, I understand. Thank you, teacher.

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。圖書館內請保持安靜。
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. tú shū guǎn nèi qǐng bǎo chí ān jìng.
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Please keep quiet in the library.

As long as no one reserved [it].

title: Borrowing Something
story_description: A student forgets a pen and asks to borrow one.
story_intro: The class is about to start.
Mark is checking his bag.
He realizes he doesn't have a pen.
He asks his neighbor for help.
They talk about borrowing and lending politely.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，不好意思，我今天忘記帶筆了。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, bù hǎo yì si, wǒ jīn tiān wàng jì dài bǐ le.
dialogue.en: David, I'm sorry, I forgot to bring a pen today.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我有兩支。你要借一支嗎？
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī. nǐ yào jiè yī zhī ma?
dialogue.en: No problem, I have two. Do you want to borrow one?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 可以嗎？太謝謝你了！
dialogue.py: kě yǐ ma? tài xiè xie nǐ le!
dialogue.en: Is it okay? Thank you so much!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 當然可以。這支黑色的借給你。
dialogue.py: dāng rán kě yǐ. zhè zhī hēi sè de jiè gěi nǐ.
dialogue.en: Of course. Borrow this black one.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 喔，這支筆寫起來很順。是新買的嗎？
dialogue.py: ō, zhè zhī bǐ xiě qǐ lái hěn shùn. shì xīn mǎi de ma?
dialogue.en: Oh, this pen writes very smoothly. Is it newly bought?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 對，昨天剛買的。你要小心用喔，別弄丟了。
dialogue.py: duì, zuó tiān gāng mǎi de. nǐ yào xiǎo xīn yòng o, bié nòng diū le.
dialogue.en: Yes, just bought it yesterday. Use it carefully, don't lose it.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我一定會小心的。課後就還給你。
dialogue.py: wǒ yī dìng huì xiǎo xīn de. kè hòu jiù huán gěi nǐ.
dialogue.en: I'll definitely be careful. I'll return it to you after class.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 不用急，你先用吧。
dialogue.py: bù yòng jí, nǐ xiān yòng ba.
dialogue.en: No rush, you use it first.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對了，你有橡皮擦嗎？我的也沒帶。
dialogue.py: duì le, nǐ yǒu xiàng pí cā ma? wǒ de yě méi dài.
dialogue.en: By the way, do you have an eraser? I didn't bring mine either.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 你也太糊塗了！橡皮擦只有一個，我們一起用吧。
dialogue.py: nǐ yě tài hú tu le! xiàng pí cā zhǐ yǒu yī gè, wǒ men yī qǐ yòng ba.
dialogue.en: You're too absent-minded! I only have one eraser, let's use it together.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，謝謝你。下次我請你喝飲料。
dialogue.py: hā hā, xiè xie nǐ. xià cì wǒ qǐng nǐ hē yǐn liào.
dialogue.en: Haha, thanks. Next time I'll treat you to a drink.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 一言為定！
dialogue.py: yī yán wéi dìng!
dialogue.en: It's a deal!

title: Simple Homework Talk
story_description: Two classmates discuss homework and due dates.
story_intro: The class has finished.
Students have some homework to do.
Two friends talk about the tasks.
They discuss if the homework is hard or easy.
They talk about when they will finish it.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 今天的功課你做了嗎？
dialogue.py: jīn tiān de gōng kè nǐ zuò le ma?
dialogue.en: Have you done today's homework?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 還沒，我打算等一下再做。你呢？
dialogue.py: hái méi, wǒ dǎ suàn děng yī xià zài zuò. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: Not yet, I plan to do it later. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我剛才看了一下，覺得有點兒難。
dialogue.py: wǒ gāng cái kàn le yī xià, jué de yǒu diǎn r nán.
dialogue.en: I just took a look, and I think it's a bit hard.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 哪一部分難？是聽寫還是閱讀？
dialogue.py: nǎ yī bù fèn nán? shì tīng xiě hái shì yuè dú?
dialogue.en: Which part is hard? Dictation or reading?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 是聽寫。老師說的很快，我聽不清楚。
dialogue.py: shì tīng xiě. lǎo shī shuō de hěn kuài, wǒ tīng bù qīng chu.
dialogue.en: It's the dictation. The teacher speaks very fast, I can't hear clearly.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒關係。閱讀很簡單，我們可以先做閱讀。
dialogue.py: méi guān xi. yuè dú hěn jiǎn dān, wǒ men kě yǐ xiān zuò yuè dú.
dialogue.en: No problem. The reading is very simple, we can do that first.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 功課什麼時候要交？
dialogue.py: gōng kè shén me shí hou yào jiāo?
dialogue.en: When should the homework be handed in?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 明天早上第一節課。你有時間跟我一起做嗎？
dialogue.py: míng tiān zǎo shang dì yī jié kè. nǐ yǒu shí jiān gēn wǒ yī qǐ zuò ma?
dialogue.en: Tomorrow morning during the first period. Do you have time to do it with me?

dialogue.speaker: Mark

title: The Test Is Tomorrow
story_description: Two students prepare for a test and talk about studying.
story_intro: There is a big test tomorrow morning.

dialogue.zh: 我也很緊張。我剛看完前三個單元，還有兩個單元沒看。

dialogue.py: nǐ hái yǒu liǎng gè dān yuán? wǒ cái fù xí wán dì yī dān yuán ne.

dialogue.py: nà nǐ yào kuài diǎn le. lǎo shī shuō dì sì dān yuán shì zhòng diǎn.

dialogue.py: zhòng diǎn? wán le, wǒ zuì pà zhòng diǎn le. wǒ xiàn zài tóu yǒu diǎn r yūn.

title: At the Doctor
story_description: A student feels sick and visits a doctor.
story_intro: Mark is not feeling well today.
He has a headache and a fever.
He goes to a nearby clinic.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 你好，哪裡不舒服？
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, nǎ lǐ bù shū fu?

dialogue.speaker: Mark

dialogue.py: yī shēng, wǒ tóu hěn téng, sǎng zi yě tòng.
dialogue.en: Doctor, I have a bad headache and my throat also hurts.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 從什麼時候開始的？發燒嗎？
dialogue.py: cóng shén me shí hou kāi shǐ de? fā shāo ma?
dialogue.en: When did it start? Do you have a fever?

dialogue.speaker: Mark

dialogue.py: cóng zuó tiān wǎn shang kāi shǐ de. gāng cái liáng le yī xià, sān shí bā dù wǔ.
dialogue.en: It started last night. I just measured it, 38.5 degrees.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 請張開嘴，讓我看看。啊——
dialogue.py: qǐng zhāng kāi zuǐ, ràng wǒ kàn kàn. ā——
dialogue.en: Please open your mouth and let me see. Ah—

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.en: Ah—

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 嗓子有點兒紅腫。咳嗽嗎？
dialogue.py: sǎng zi yǒu diǎn r hóng zhǒng. ké sou ma?
dialogue.en: The throat is a bit red and swollen. Do you have a cough?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有一點兒，特別是晚上的時候。
dialogue.py: yǒu yī diǎn r, tè bié shì wǎn shang de shí hou.
dialogue.en: A little bit, especially at night.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，是普通的感冒。我給你開點藥。
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, shì pǔ tōng de gǎn mào. wǒ gěi nǐ kāi diǎn yào.
dialogue.en: It's okay; it's a common cold. I'll prescribe some medicine for you.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝醫生。這藥怎麼吃？
dialogue.py: xiè xie yī shēng. zhè yào zěn me chī?
dialogue.en: Thank you, doctor. How should I take this medicine?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 一天三次，飯後吃。你要多喝水，多休息。
dialogue.py: yī tiān sān cì, fàn hòu chī. nǐ yào duō hē shuǐ, duō xiū xi.
dialogue.en: Three times a day, take after meals. You need to drink plenty of water and rest a lot.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，我知道了。謝謝醫生。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, wǒ zhī dào le. xiè xie yī shēng.
dialogue.en: Okay, I got it. Thank you, doctor.

part_c: 你生病時會去看醫生嗎？

title: I Don’t Feel Well
story_description: A student tells the teacher they feel sick and need to go home.
story_intro: The class is ongoing.
Mark feels very weak and dizzy.
He goes to the teacher's desk.
He explains his situation and asks for permission.
The teacher shows concern and gives instructions.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 老師，不好意思，我想請假。
dialogue.py: lǎo shī, bù hǎo yì si, wǒ xiǎng qǐng jià.
dialogue.en: Teacher, sorry, I'd like to ask for leave.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 怎麼了，馬克？哪裡不舒服？
dialogue.py: zěn me le, mǎ kè? nǎ lǐ bù shū fu?
dialogue.en: What's wrong, Mark? Where do you feel unwell?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我肚子很疼，覺得渾身沒勁兒。
dialogue.py: wǒ dù zi hěn téng, jué de hún shēn méi jìn r.
dialogue.en: My stomach hurts badly, and I feel weak all over.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 臉色看起來也不太好。是不是吃壞肚子了？
dialogue.py: liǎn sè kàn qǐ lái yě bù tài hǎo. shì bù shì chī huài dù zi le?
dialogue.en: Your complexion doesn't look too good either. Did you eat something bad?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 可能吧。我想回宿舍休息一下。
dialogue.py: kě néng ba. wǒ xiǎng huí sù shè xiū xi yī xià.
dialogue.en: Maybe. I want to go back to the dormitory to rest for a bit.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 好。你自己能回去嗎？要不要人陪？
dialogue.py: hǎo. nǐ zì jǐ néng huí qù ma? yào bù yào rén péi?
dialogue.en: Okay. Can you go back by yourself? Do you need someone to accompany you?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我可以自己回去。宿舍離這裡不遠。
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, wǒ kě yǐ zì jǐ huí qù. sù shè lí zhè lǐ bù yuǎn.
dialogue.en: No problem, I can go back by myself. The dorm is not far from here.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 那你回去以後先休息。如果還疼，一定要去看醫生。
dialogue.py: nà nǐ huí qù yǐ hòu xiān xiū xi. rú guǒ hái téng, yī dìng yào qù kàn yī shēng.
dialogue.en: Then rest first after you get back. If it still hurts, you must go see a doctor.

dialogue.py: hǎo de. míng tiān de zuò yè wǒ huì bǔ jiāo de.
dialogue.en: Okay. I will make up and hand in tomorrow's homework later.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.en: The homework is not urgent. Health is the most important. Go back and rest quickly.

dialogue.speaker: Mark

dialogue.py: xiè xie lǎo shī, lǎo shī zài jiàn.
dialogue.en: Thank you, teacher. Goodbye, teacher.

dialogue.py: zài jiàn. zhù nǐ zǎo rì kāng fù.

title: Buying Medicine
story_description: A customer asks a pharmacist for basic medicine.
story_intro: Mark is at a pharmacy.
He needs to buy medicine for his fever and cough.
He talks to the pharmacist.
He asks about the effects and usage of the medicine.
The pharmacist gives him instructions and tips.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想買點感冒藥和止咳藥。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng mǎi diǎn gǎn mào yào hé zhǐ ké yào.

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.zh: 好的。你有什麼症狀？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. nǐ yǒu shén me zhèng zhuàng?

dialogue.speaker: Mark

dialogue.py: wǒ fā shāo le, sān shí bā dù. hái yǒu diǎn r ké sou, sǎng zi gān téng.
dialogue.en: I have a fever, 38 degrees. Also a bit of a cough, and my throat is dry and painful.

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.zh: 這盒是退燒藥，效果很好。這瓶是止咳糖漿。
dialogue.py: zhè hé shì tuì shāo yào, xiào guǒ hěn hǎo. zhè píng shì zhǐ ké táng jiāng.
dialogue.en: This box is fever-reducing medicine, the effect is very good. This bottle is cough syrup.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這兩種藥可以一起吃嗎？
dialogue.py: zhè liǎng zhǒng yào kě yǐ yī qǐ chī ma?
dialogue.en: Can these two kinds of medicine be taken together?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.zh: 可以。退燒藥一天兩次，早晚各一粒。糖漿一天三次，每次十毫升。
dialogue.py: kě yǐ. tuì shāo yào yī tiān liǎng cì, zǎo wǎn gè yī lì. táng jiāng yī tiān sān cì, měi cì shí háo shēng.
dialogue.en: Yes. Fever medicine twice a day, one pill each morning and evening. Syrup three times a day, 10ml each time.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 吃了這個藥會不會想睡覺？
dialogue.py: chī le zhè ge yào huì bù huì xiǎng shuì jiào?
dialogue.en: Will taking this medicine make me want to sleep?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist

dialogue.en: The fever medicine might make you a bit sleepy. So don't drive after taking the medicine.

dialogue.speaker: Mark

dialogue.py: hǎo de. chú le chī yào, hái yào zhù yì shén me?
dialogue.en: Okay. Besides taking medicine, what else should I pay attention to?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist

dialogue.py: yào zhù yì bǎo nuǎn, bié chuī fēng. duō chī diǎn qīng dàn de shí wù.

dialogue.speaker: Mark

story_description: Two friends order food at a small restaurant.

dialogue.speaker: Mark

dialogue.py: mǐ fàn ba, liǎng wǎn mǐ fàn.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter

dialogue.py: hǎo de. yào hē diǎn r shén me ma? zhè lǐ yǒu miǎn fèi de rè chá.

dialogue.py: rè chá jiù kě yǐ le. xiè xie.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter

dialogue.py: hǎo de, qǐng shāo děng. cài mǎ shàng jiù lái.

dialogue.speaker: David

dialogue.py: zhè jiā cān tīng huán jìng zhēn bù cuò.

title: The Food Is Too Spicy
story_description: A customer asks about spicy and non-spicy food.
story_intro: The food has arrived at the table.
Mark tries the braised pork.
He finds it a bit spicy.
He talks to the waiter about the taste.
They discuss how to order less spicy food next time.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （吃了一口）哇，這道菜好辣！
dialogue.py: (chī le yī kǒu) wa, zhè dào cài hǎo là!
dialogue.en: (After a bite) Wow, this dish is so spicy!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？我覺得還好。你不能吃辣嗎？
dialogue.py: zhēn de ma? wǒ jué de hái hǎo. nǐ bù néng chī là ma?
dialogue.en: Really? I think it's okay. You can't eat spicy food?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我能吃一點兒，但是這個太辣了，我的嗓子都要冒火了。
dialogue.py: wǒ néng chī yī diǎn r, dàn shì zhè ge tài là le, wǒ de sǎng zi dōu yào mào huǒ le.
dialogue.en: I can eat a little, but this is too spicy; my throat feels like it's on fire.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 服務員，請給我一杯冰水，謝謝。
dialogue.py: fú wù yuán, qǐng gěi wǒ yī bēi bīng shuǐ, xiè xie.
dialogue.en: Waiter, please give me a glass of ice water, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.zh: 好的。對不起，這道菜是中辣的。你要換成微辣嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. duì bù qǐ, zhè dào cài shì zhōng là de. nǐ yào huàn chéng wēi là ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. Sorry, this dish is medium spicy. Do you want to change it to mild spicy?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 現在不用換了，我多喝點水。下次我會記得點微辣的。
dialogue.py: xiàn zài bù yòng huàn le, wǒ duō hē diǎn shuǐ. xià cì wǒ huì jì de diǎn wēi là de.
dialogue.en: No need to change now, I'll drink more water. Next time I'll remember to order mild spicy.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 這魚排一點兒也不辣，你嚐嚐看。
dialogue.py: zhè yú pái yī diǎn r yě bù là, nǐ cháng chang kàn.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （嚐了一口）嗯，這個味道很清淡，剛好合我的口味。
dialogue.py: (cháng le yī kǒu) en, zhè ge wèi dào hěn qīng dàn, gāng hǎo hé wǒ de kǒu wèi.
dialogue.en: (Tries a bite) Hmm, this taste is very light, just right for my palate.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 那你多吃點魚吧。除了辣，這肉的味道其實不錯。
dialogue.py: nà nǐ duō chī diǎn yú ba. chú le là, zhè ròu de wèi dào qí shí bù cuò.
dialogue.en: Then eat more fish. Besides being spicy, the taste of this meat is actually good.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，如果沒那麼辣就完美了。
dialogue.py: duì, rú guǒ méi nà me là jiù wán měi le.
dialogue.en: Yes, if it weren't so spicy, it would be perfect.

dialogue.speaker: David

dialogue.py: (xiào) hǎo le, kuài hē shuǐ ba.
dialogue.en: (Laughs) Okay, drink some water quickly.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，冰水舒服多了。
dialogue.py: xiè xie, bīng shuǐ shū fu duō le.
dialogue.en: Thanks, the ice water makes it much more comfortable.

title: Taking a Taxi

dialogue.py: bù hǎo yì si, qǐng wèn yī xià, qù lóng shān sì zěn me zǒu?

dialogue.py: lóng shān sì? lí zhè lǐ yǒu yī duàn lù. nǐ xiàn zài zǒu fǎn le.

dialogue.en: First cross the street, then go straight forward.

title: On the Bus
story_description: A passenger asks where to get off.
story_intro: Mark is sitting on a bus.
He is going to a new place.

dialogue.py: nǐ zài 'zhōng shān gōng yuán' zhàn xià chē. nà lǐ lí měi shù guǎn zuì jìn.
dialogue.en: Get off at 'Zhongshan Park' stop. That's closest to the museum.

dialogue.speaker: Mark

dialogue.py: xià yī zhàn shì zhōng shān gōng yuán ma?

dialogue.py: hǎo de, fēi cháng gǎn xiè nǐ de bāng zhù.

title: A Rainy Day Problem
story_description: Two friends change their plan because it is raining.
story_intro: Mark and David planned to go to the park.
But suddenly, it starts raining heavily.
They are stuck indoors.
They talk about the weather and their cancelled plans.
They decide to do something else indoors instead.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 看，外面突然下起大雨了。
dialogue.py: kàn, wài miàn tū rán xià qǐ dà yǔ le.
dialogue.en: Look, it suddenly started raining hard outside.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 是啊，剛才還是晴天呢。看來我們去不了公園了。
dialogue.py: shì a, gāng cái hái shì qíng tiān ne. kàn lái wǒ men qù bù liǎo gōng yuán le.
dialogue.en: Yeah, it was just sunny. Looks like we can't go to the park anymore.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 真倒霉！我本來很期待去野餐的。
dialogue.py: zhēn dǎo méi! wǒ běn lái hěn qī dài qù yě cān de.
dialogue.en: So unlucky! I was really looking forward to the picnic.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，下雨天也沒辦法。你帶傘了嗎？
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, xià yǔ tiān yě méi bàn fǎ. nǐ dài sǎn le ma?
dialogue.en: No problem, nothing can be done on a rainy day. Did you bring an umbrella?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 帶了，但是風太大，打傘也沒用。
dialogue.py: dài le, dàn shì fēng tài dà, dǎ sǎn yě méi yòng.
dialogue.en: I did, but the wind is too strong; even an umbrella is useless.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 那我們現在做什麼？一直待在教室裡也很悶。
dialogue.py: nà wǒ men xiàn zài zuò shén me? yī zhí dāi zài jiào shì lǐ yě hěn mèn.
dialogue.en: So what do we do now? Staying in the classroom all the time is also very boring.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 要不我們去逛商場吧？那裡在室內，不會淋雨。
dialogue.py: yào bù wǒ men qù guàng shāng chǎng ba? nà lǐ zài shì nèi, bù huì lín yǔ.
dialogue.en: How about we go wander the shopping mall? It's indoors there, we won't get rained on.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好主意！商場裡還有電影院，我們可以看場電影。
dialogue.py: hǎo zhǔ yì! shāng chǎng lǐ hái yǒu diàn yǐng yuàn, wǒ men kě yǐ kàn chǎng diàn yǐng.
dialogue.en: Good idea! There's also a cinema in the mall; we can watch a movie.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！那我們怎麼去？坐公車還是打車？
dialogue.py: tài bàng le! nà wǒ men zěn me qù? zuò gōng chē hái shì dǎ chē?
dialogue.en: Great! How shall we get there? Take the bus or catch a cab?

dialogue.speaker: David

dialogue.py: gōng chē zhàn lí zhè lǐ yǒu diǎn r yuǎn, hái shì dǎ chē ba, zhí jiē dào mén kǒu.
dialogue.en: The bus stop is a bit far from here; let's catch a cab instead, goes straight to the door.

dialogue.speaker: Mark

dialogue.py: xíng. nà wǒ xiàn zài yòng shǒu jī jiào chē.
dialogue.en: Okay. Then I'll call a car with my phone now.

dialogue.speaker: David

dialogue.py: hǎo, wǒ men zài mén tīng děng chē ba.
dialogue.en: Okay, let's wait for the car in the lobby.

title: Cleaning My Room
story_description: A parent asks a child to clean their room before going out.
story_intro: The weekend morning has arrived.
Mark's room is very messy.
His mother is not happy about it.
She asks him to clean up before he can go play.
They talk about specific tasks like sweeping and organizing.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你看看你的房間，也太亂了吧！
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ kàn kàn nǐ de fáng jiān, yě tài luàn le ba!
dialogue.en: Mark, look at your room, it's way too messy!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 媽，我知道了。我等一下再收。
dialogue.py: mā, wǒ zhī dào le. wǒ děng yī xià zài shōu.
dialogue.en: Mom, I know. I'll tidy up later.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 不行！你現在就得收。你下午不是要出去玩嗎？
dialogue.py: bù xíng! nǐ xiàn zài jiù děi shōu. nǐ xià wǔ bù shì yào chū qù wán ma?
dialogue.en: No! You have to tidy up right now. Aren't you going out to play this afternoon?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，我要跟大衛去打球。
dialogue.py: duì, wǒ yào gēn dà wèi qù dǎ qiú.
dialogue.en: Yes, I'm going to play ball with David.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 那你在出門前，必須把房間整理乾淨。
dialogue.py: nà nǐ zài chū mén qián, bì xū bǎ fáng jiān zhěng lǐ gān jìng.
dialogue.en: Then before you go out, you must organize your room clean.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好吧。我要做哪些事？
dialogue.py: hǎo ba. wǒ yào zuò nǎ xiē shì?
dialogue.en: Okay then. What things do I need to do?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 先要把衣服疊好，放在櫃子裡。書桌也要收拾一下。
dialogue.py: xiān yào bǎ yī fu dié hǎo, fàng zài guì zi lǐ. shū zhuō yě yào shōu shi yī xià.
dialogue.en: First, you need to fold the clothes well and put them in the closet. The desk also needs to be tidied up.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 还要掃地嗎？
dialogue.py: hái yào sǎo dì ma?
dialogue.en: Do I still need to sweep the floor?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 當然要。地板上有不少灰塵。最後記得倒垃圾。
dialogue.py: dāng rán yào. dì bǎn shàng yǒu bù shǎo huī chén. zuì hòu jì de dào lā jī.
dialogue.en: Of course. There's quite a bit of dust on the floor. Finally, remember to take out the trash.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 这么多事啊！這得花不少時間吧。
dialogue.py: zhè me duō shì a! zhè děi huā bù shǎo shí jiān ba.
dialogue.en: So many things! This will probably take quite a lot of time.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 只要你動作快一點兒，半個小時就能做完。
dialogue.py: zhǐ yào nǐ dòng zuò kuài yī diǎn r, bàn gè xiǎo shí jiù néng zuò wán.
dialogue.en: As long as your movements are a bit faster, you can finish in half an hour.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 行，我現在就開始。完成任務就能出去玩了！
dialogue.py: xíng, wǒ xiàn zài jiù kāi shǐ. wán chéng rèn wu jiù néng chū qù wán le!
dialogue.en: Fine, I'll start right now. Once I complete the mission, I can go out to play!

title: Review Story: A Busy Weekend
story_description: A learner shops, eats out, travels by bus, gets sick, and changes plans.
story_intro: Mark has had a very busy weekend.
He did many things in the city.
He wrote a diary entry about his experiences.
He mentions shopping, eating, transport, and health.
He reflects on his progress in Stage 2.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 五月十九號，星期日，晴轉多雲。
dialogue.py: wǔ yuè shí jiǔ hào, xīng qī rì, qíng zhuǎn duō yún.
dialogue.en: May 19th, Sunday, sunny turning cloudy.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這個週末我過得非常充實，但也有一點兒累。
dialogue.py: zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ guò de fēi cháng chōng shí, dàn yě yǒu yī diǎn r lèi.
dialogue.en: I had a very productive weekend, but also a bit tired.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 昨天上午，我先去便利商店買了點零食和水。
dialogue.py: zuó tiān shàng wǔ, wǒ xiān qù biàn lì shāng diàn mǎi le diǎn líng shí hé shuǐ.
dialogue.en: Yesterday morning, I first went to the convenience store to buy some snacks and water.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 然後我坐公車去火車站接父母。公車差點誤點，真緊張。
dialogue.py: rán hòu wǒ zuò gōng chē qù huǒ chē zhàn jiē fù mǔ. gōng chē chà diǎn wù diǎn, zhēn jǐn zhāng.
dialogue.en: Then I took the bus to the train station to pick up my parents. The bus almost was delayed; so nervous.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 中午我們去了一家有名的餐廳，點了紅燒肉和清蒸魚。
dialogue.py: zhōng wǔ wǒ men qù le yī jiā yǒu míng de cān tīng, diǎn le hóng shāo ròu hé qīng zhēng yú.
dialogue.en: At noon we went to a famous restaurant and ordered braised pork and steamed fish.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 爸爸覺得菜有點兒辣，但他很喜歡那個味道。
dialogue.py: bà ba jué de cài yǒu diǎn r là, dàn tā hěn xǐ huan nà gè wèi dào.
dialogue.en: Dad thought the dishes were a bit spicy, but he liked the taste very much.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 下午突然下大雨了，我們只好打車去逛百貨公司。
dialogue.py: xià wǔ tū rán xià dà yǔ le, wǒ men zhǐ hǎo dǎ chē qù guàng bǎi huò gōng sī.
dialogue.en: In the afternoon it suddenly rained hard, so we had to take a taxi to browse the department store.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 晚上我覺得肚子有點兒疼，可能是吃壞東西了。
dialogue.py: wǎn shang wǒ jué de dù zi yǒu diǎn r téng, kě néng shì chī huài dōng xi le.
dialogue.en: At night my stomach hurt a bit; maybe I ate something bad.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我吃了一粒感冒藥，早早就睡了。今天早上感覺舒服多了。
dialogue.py: wǒ chī le yī lì gǎn mào yào, zǎo zǎo jiù shuì le. jīn tiān zǎo shang gǎn jué shū fu duō le.
dialogue.en: I took a cold pill and went to sleep early. This morning I feel much better.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我現在學會了怎麼訂餐、買票和問路。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiàn zài xué huì le zěn me dìng cān, mǎi piào hé wèn lù.
dialogue.en: I've now learned how to order meals, buy tickets, and ask for directions.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 中文真的很有用。下個週末我打算去台中旅遊。
dialogue.py: zhōng wén zhēn de hěn yǒu yòng. xià gè zhōu mò wǒ dǎ suàn qù tái zhōng lǚ yóu.
dialogue.en: Chinese is really useful. Next weekend I plan to go to Taichung to travel.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 加油，馬克！你可以的。
dialogue.py: jiā yóu, mǎ kè! nǐ kě yǐ de.
dialogue.en: Keep it up, Mark! You can do it.
